guidance.relation_criterion: Resolve every independent definition route and exception. Explicit-identification is Entailment only if every protected route requires a discloser act such as marking, designation, oral identification, written confirmation, or identification through a closed document list. A route based merely on nature, circumstances, recipient knowledge, or reasonable understanding makes the universal hypothesis Contradiction. Technical-only is Entailment only when every included subject is necessarily technical. Contradiction requires an expressly nontechnical category such as business, financial, personnel, customer, contractual, marketing, or operational information; generic references to information, documents, transaction material, evaluation material, or named artifacts with unresolved content do not alone establish nontechnical scope. Oral coverage requires express oral, verbal, spoken, universal-form, or equivalent language; generic disclosure, communications, dealings, inspection, or access does not suffice. Agreement-confidentiality requires both a protected agreement-related subject and an operative nondisclosure or publicity duty.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For universal identification, include every independently operative definition route; for a closed-list definition, include its lead-in and all members needed to establish the complete scope. For technical exclusivity, include all independently decisive technical or nontechnical categories, not generic surrounding language. For oral coverage, include the form rule, necessary definition lead-in, and any confirmation condition; if the form rule governs an enumeration, retain the governed enumeration required by the annotation. For agreement-confidentiality, include the protected subject and operative restriction. Retain independently responsive repetitions; omit headings, recitals, examples that do not affect scope, and unrelated duties.

guidance.relation_criterion: Decide endpoint disposition, survival, and retained possession separately. Return-or-destroy is Entailment only when termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, rejection, failure to proceed, cessation, or another relationship-ending event activates the duty. A request-only duty is NotMentioned for this hypothesis; an independent endpoint branch still entails it. Survival requires an obligation expressly continuing after an endpoint or remaining effective despite return or destruction; a mere agreement term, remedy, severability clause, or request duty is insufficient. Post-disposition possession is Entailment when retention is expressly allowed or required for legal, compliance, archival, backup, evidentiary, or infeasibility reasons. It is Contradiction when an applicable disposition command requires return or destruction of all covered information, embodied materials, records, or copies and supplies no retention route; this question may be resolved by a request-triggered disposition clause even though return-or-destroy upon termination is not. A command addressing only a genuinely nonexhaustive subset leaves possession unresolved.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For return-or-destroy, select the endpoint trigger and complete disposition command, including alternative return and destruction branches; exclude request-only clauses and collateral certification unless inseparable. For survival, select the continuation language and any referenced duties needed to identify what continues. For retained possession, select every operative retention or infeasibility route plus governing disposition language. For Contradiction, select the complete no-retention disposition command and language establishing its comprehensive scope. Retain independently operative repeated rules but omit remedies, fixed terms, and ordinary confidentiality provisions.

guidance.relation_criterion: Test present authority to create a new copy, reproduction, duplicate, record, written reduction, photograph, or comparable embodiment. Entailment requires affirmative permission, including an exception allowing copies strictly or reasonably necessary for a purpose or authorized recipient. A narrow copying right counts even inside a no-license, use, confidentiality, or intellectual-property clause. A categorical copying ban, or a prohibition whose only exception is future consent, is Contradiction rather than NotMentioned. Do not infer creation authority from use, access, delivery, possession, disclosure, return of existing copies, retention of an existing archival copy, or references to copies already made. Backup language entails only when it authorizes creating or maintaining backup copies.
guidance.evidence_criterion: Select the operative copying verb, actor, modality, and purpose or recipient condition. For an exception within a prohibition, include both portions needed to establish present permission. For a consent gate or categorical ban, include the prohibition and shared lead-in establishing actor and object. Retain separately operative copying rules. Exclude return provisions, existing-copy references, retention exceptions, general use or disclosure permissions, and adjacent reverse-engineering, security, or ownership text unless grammatically necessary.

guidance.relation_criterion: Keep the two provenance routes distinct. Independent-development Entailment requires express development, creation, or derivation by the receiving party independently and ordinarily without use, access, reference, or reliance on protected information. Prior knowledge, prior possession, lawful acquisition before disclosure, permitted use, or employee-sharing is not independent development. Third-party-acquisition Entailment requires receipt, obtainment, or learning by the receiving party from an external source entitled to disclose and not bound by the relevant confidentiality restriction. Disclosure by the owner to another person, or permission to share with representatives, is not acquisition by the receiver. An affirmative freedom to develop or acquire similar products, services, or technology supports the matching hypothesis. An express ban is Contradiction; otherwise absence is NotMentioned.
guidance.evidence_criterion: Select the exact provenance prong and its shared exclusion introduction when that introduction supplies the legal consequence. Include attached no-use, no-access, proof, lawful-source, right-to-disclose, and no-confidentiality conditions. Retain a separate freedom-to-develop or freedom-to-acquire clause when independently responsive. Exclude public-domain, prior-possession, disclosure-by-owner, employee-sharing, warranty, and unrelated provenance prongs.

guidance.relation_criterion: Read the general prohibition, definitions, specific permissions, and later exceptions together. Employee-sharing is Entailment when an operative rule permits at least some receiving-party employees to receive protected information, subject to any need-to-know, purpose, designation, undertaking, training, or liability conditions. Language expressly contemplating necessary employee dissemination and imposing confidentiality obligations can supply permission. Third-party-sharing is Entailment only for standing permission covering an expressly external or potentially external class such as agents, consultants, advisers, counsel, contractors, subcontractors, or other representatives. A definition alone is not permission. A later specific consent gate or prohibition for the tested external class defeats a generic representative reference. Permission confined to employees, officers, or directors is Contradiction for third-party sharing. Do not infer employees from an undifferentiated third-party class or from affiliate status. Silence is NotMentioned.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For Entailment, select the operative permission or necessary-dissemination rule, responsive class, and all attached need-to-know, purpose, undertaking, or responsibility conditions. For Contradiction, select the general prohibition with the exclusive whitelist, later specific prohibition, or consent gate closing the tested class. Retain separately operative recipient permissions. Exclude definitions unconnected to permission, security rules, ownership clauses, third-party-beneficiary text, and unrelated use restrictions.

guidance.relation_criterion: Entailment requires operative language withholding a license, title, interest, ownership, immunity, intellectual-property right, or other right in protected information, or reserving exclusive ownership so the recipient acquires none. An ownership reservation can suffice without the word license. Consider all scoped exceptions and affirmative grants. Contradiction requires an actual grant of a substantive right in the same protected object; limited permission to review, copy, use, or disclose information for the stated purpose does not by itself contradict the hypothesis. Do not infer no-rights from confidentiality, limited use, entire-agreement, no-warranty, remedy, or no-commitment language, and do not confuse unrelated definition categories with licensing.
guidance.evidence_criterion: Select every independently operative ownership-reservation or no-license/no-right provision contributing to the result, including distinct information and intellectual-property rules. For Contradiction, select the actual affirmative grant and its scope. Exclude definition categories, permitted-purpose clauses, disclosure mechanics, warranties, commercialization language, remedies, and administrative terms unless they themselves grant or withhold the relevant right.

guidance.relation_criterion: Match actor, object, conduct, polarity, trigger, and exceptions. Limited-use Entailment requires an operative sole-purpose, necessary-purpose, or no-other-purpose restriction; because the hypothesis is prohibitory, a use prohibition supports it. Compelled-disclosure notice requires notice or consultation tied to law, regulation, subpoena, court, government, or comparable compulsory process; permission to disclose, confidentiality efforts, or incident reporting without that notice duty is insufficient. Reverse-engineering Entailment requires an express ban on reverse engineering, decompiling, disassembling, or a stated equivalent directed at software, products, prototypes, tangible objects, or protected information; such a ban supports the prohibitory hypothesis. No-solicitation Entailment requires an express solicitation, inducement, hiring, employment, retention, or services-contracting ban covering the specified representatives; such a ban also supports rather than contradicts the hypothesis. Contact controls, advertising rules, noncompetition, and nondisclosure are not substitutes. Express permission for the same conduct is Contradiction; silence is NotMentioned.
guidance.evidence_criterion: For limited use, select each independently operative restriction and any incorporated purpose or exception required for scope. For compelled notice, select the compulsory trigger and notice or consultation duty, retaining independently operative pre- and post-disclosure duties. For reverse engineering, select the exact prohibition and object. For solicitation, select every responsive solicitation, hiring, employment, retention, or inducement ban plus shared duration and operative exceptions. Exclude neighboring disclosure, security, copying, ownership, contact, standstill, remedy, and publicity provisions unless they grammatically supply the tested rule.

delta.noop_reason: NOOP: the current seven-skill library already encodes the source-observable corrections demonstrated by the supplied parent failures, including endpoint-versus-request disposition triggers, retention exceptions, copy-permission boundaries, distinct provenance routes, recipient-class consent gates, no-license versus mere restrictions, exact conduct polarity, and complete independently responsive evidence selection. The remaining errors are applications of existing guidance or source-specific annotation variance, not a supported reusable rule change.
